notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - Steam Cloud
notes.notes:
Steam Cloud support has been added!

Additional changes:
- fixed a bug where the first node of a chapter was not rendered properly
- fixed a bug where the dialogue would be re-rendered when trying to select a reply
- fixed additional spelling errors

notes.title: Bugfix 0.1.3
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that would crash the game when pressing TAB in certain circumstances.

Typos fixed.

Thanks @rick.12

notes.title: Bugfix 0.1.2
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the game would crash on typing an action.

notes.title: Compatibility update
notes.notes:
Fixed issues that prevented launching the game through the Steam client on Linux/SteamOS and Mac. 

Thanks to [b]#theITAXx[/b] and [b]#pask_92354 [/b] for helping with troubleshooting/testing.

And thank you all for the patience!
